metadata.title: Maya aur Jagat
metadata.subtitle: Sansar jaisa dikhta hai, kya waise hi hai?
metadata.terminology_note: Is adhyay mein fixed Nirvan Sutra lexicon ka palan hai: Maya jagat-star par ek satya ka anek naam-roop mein dikhna hai; Avidya vyakti-star par sharir-man ko main maan lena hai.
intro_paras: Yeh Nirvan Sutra course ka doosra adhyay hai. Pehle adhyay mein saadhak ne sharir, man, anubhavkarta aur saakshi ki prarambhik jaanch ki thi. Ab wahi drishti sansar ki or mudti hai.

Yahan Maya shabd ka prayog fixed course lexicon ke anusaar hai: vah shakti jiske kaaran ek advaita satya anek naam, roop aur anubhav ke roop mein dikhai deta hai. Uddeshya sansar ko nakarna nahi, balki use spashtata, karuna aur santulan se dekhna hai.

sections.title: Pehle Adhyay se Aage: Bheetar se Bahar ki Or
sections.content:
Pehle adhyay, Swayam Ki Khoj, mein humne bheetar ki or dekha. Humne sharir ko dekha, man ko dekha, anubhavkarta ko dekha, aur dheere-dheere us shant jaanne wali upasthiti ki or mudna shuru kiya jise is course mein saakshi kaha gaya.

Ab wahi saakshi bahar ki or dekhta hai.

Bahar yeh poora sansar dikhai deta hai: log, vastu, sambandh, kaam, ghar, raaste, awaazein, rang, sukh, dukh, samay aur sthan. Sab kuch itna thos, itna real lagta hai ki aam jeevan mein hum is par sawal hi nahi uthate.

Lekin ab saadhak ke bheetar dekhne ki ek nayi drishti jag rahi hai. Saadhak ab sirf anubhav mein behna nahi chahta. Vah dekhna chahta hai ki anubhav banta kaise hai.

Prashn uthta hai:

Kya yeh sansar bilkul waise hi hai jaise mujhe dikh raha hai?

Aur agar saakshi hi achal satya ki or pehla dwar hai, to yeh jagat, jo itna vishal aur real lagta hai, kahan se aaya? Yeh kya hai? Iska sthan kya hai?

Is adhyay mein hum isi prashn ki or dheere-dheere chalenge. Jaldi koi nishkarsh nahi nikalenge. Abhi sansar ko jhooth nahi kahenge. Abhi sansar ko nakarenge nahi. Abhi sirf itna dekhenge ki jis sansar ko hum antim satya maan lete hain, kya vah sach mein utna seedha aur nishchit hai jitna pehli nazar mein lagta hai.

sections.title: Sansar Kitna Real Lagta Hai
sections.content:
Subah aankh khulti hai. Kamre ki deewar dikhai deti hai. Khidki se roshni aati hai. Bahar kisi gaadi ki awaaz sunai deti hai. Phone par message dikhta hai. Sharir bistar se uthta hai. Din shuru hota hai.

Sab kuch bahut seedha lagta hai.

Yeh bistar hai. Yeh kamra hai. Yeh mera phone hai. Yeh mera ghar hai. Yeh shehar hai. Yeh log hain. Yeh duniya hai.

Hum in baaton par sawal nahi karte. Humein lagta hai ki yeh sab bas hai - jaisa dikh raha hai, waise hi hai.

Sadak par chalte hue gaadiyan dikhti hain. Bazaar mein log dikhte hain. Dukaan mein vastu dikhti hain. Koi muskura raha hai, koi jaldi mein hai, koi pareshan dikh raha hai. Awaazein aati hain - baatcheet, horn, music, bachchon ki awaaz, dukandar ki pukar.

Rang dikhte hain. Aakar dikhte hain. Doori mehsoos hoti hai. Samay chal raha hai aisa lagta hai. Subah se dopahar, dopahar se shaam, shaam se raat. Jeevan ek badi dhara ki tarah chalta rehta hai.

Aur yeh sab itna thos lagta hai ki koi kahe, "Isko dekho, iski jaanch karo," to man turant kehta hai, "Isme jaanchne jaisa kya hai? Sansar to saamne saaf dikh raha hai."

Yahin se sadhana ki gehrai shuru hoti hai.

Adhyatma yeh nahi kehta ki jo dikh raha hai use nakar do. Adhyatma kehta hai - jo dikh raha hai, use thoda aur gehrai se dekho.

Ek table tumhe table dikhai deti hai. Tum us par haath rakhte ho, vah thos lagti hai. Us par kitab rakhi ja sakti hai. Us par bhojan rakha ja sakta hai. Vyavahar mein vah table hai. Isme koi samasya nahi.

Lekin jab hum kehte hain, "Yahi poora satya hai," tab prashn uthta hai - kya hum sach mein poora satya dekh rahe hain? Ya hum utna hi dekh rahe hain jitna hamari indriyan aur man humein dikha rahe hain?

Yeh prashn sansar ko mitane ke liye nahi hai. Yeh prashn dekhne ki gehrai badhane ke liye hai.

sections.title: Kya Sabko Sansar Ek Jaisa Dikhta Hai?
sections.content:
Ab ek bahut simple baat dekho.

Bahar baarish ho rahi hai.

Ek kisan use dekhkar khush ho sakta hai - "Fasal ke liye achha hai." Ek yatri pareshan ho sakta hai - "Raasta kharab ho jayega." Ek kavi use dekhkar bhavuk ho sakta hai. Ek dukandar soch sakta hai - "Aaj grahak kam aayenge." Ek bachcha khush hokar bheegna chahega. Ek bimaar vyakti keh sakta hai - "Thand badh jayegi."

Baarish ek hai. Anubhav alag-alag hai.

Ab ek gaana lo.

Wahi gaana kisi ko bahut pyara lag sakta hai, kyunki usse koi purani yaad judi hai. Kisi doosre ko wahi gaana normal lag sakta hai. Kisi teesre ko shor lag sakta hai. Kisi chauthe ko usse koi farq hi nahi padta.

Gaana ek hai. Anubhav alag-alag hai.

Ab ek vyakti ko dekho.

Kisi ke liye vah bahut priya hai. Kisi ke liye vah sadharan hai. Kisi ke liye vah dar ka karan hai. Kisi ke liye samman ka patra hai. Kisi ke liye bheed mein bas ek chehra hai.

Vyakti ek hai. Anubhav sabka alag hai.

Yahan ek subtle baat samajhni hai. Sansar ka anubhav sirf bahar ki vastu se nahi banta. Usme bheetar ki drishti bhi judi hoti hai.

Jo hum dekhte hain, usme hamari yaadein, ichchha, dar, pasand, napasand, purane anubhav aur ummeedein apna rang mila deti hain.

Isiliye ek hi ghatna kisi ko avsar lagti hai aur kisi ko sankat. Ek hi shabd kisi ko prem jaisa lagta hai aur kisi ko chot jaisa. Ek hi maun kisi ko shanti deta hai aur kisi ko akelapan.

To kya sansar sirf bahar hai? Ya sansar ka anubhav bahar aur bheetar, dono se milkar banta hai?

Yeh prashn bahut mahatvapurn hai.

Kyuki aam taur par hum kehte hain - "Duniya ne mujhe dukh diya." Lekin gehrai se dekhne par dikhai deta hai ki ghatna bahar hui, par uska arth man ne banaya. Anubhav mein bahar ki ghatna bhi hai, aur bheetar ki vyakhya bhi.

Yahan bhi jaldi mat karo. Abhi sirf itna dekho ki sansar ka anubhav utna seedha nahi hai jitna pehli nazar mein lagta hai.

sections.title: Hum Sansar Ko Seedhe Nahi Dekhte
sections.content:
Hum aam taur par kehte hain - "Maine dekha", "Maine suna", "Maine chhua", "Maine anubhav kiya."

Lekin thoda gehrai se dekhein to spasht hota hai ki hum sansar ko seedhe nahi dekhte. Hum sansar ko apni indriyon aur man ke madhyam se jaante hain.

Aankh roop aur rang dikhati hai. Kaan awaaz sunate hain. Twacha sparsh ka anubhav deti hai. Jeebh swaad batati hai. Naak gandh batati hai. Aur man in sab ko jodkar kehta hai - "Yeh sansar hai."

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki indriyan galat hain. Indriyan jeevan ke liye bahut upyogi hain. Inse hum raasta dekhte hain, awaaz sunte hain, bhojan pehchante hain, khatre se bachte hain. Indriyan sadhan hain.

Lekin har sadhan ki seema hoti hai.

Aankh har prakaar ki roshni nahi dekh sakti. Vah sirf ek certain range tak rang aur prakash dekhti hai. Bahut si tarangein hain jo aankh ko dikhai nahi deti. Kaan bhi har prakaar ki dhwani nahi sun sakte. Bahut dheemi ya bahut tez dhwani hamari sunne ki seema ke bahar hoti hai.

Saral arth yeh hai ki jo humein dikhai aur sunai deta hai, wahi poora nahi hai. Vah hamare anubhav ki seema ke andar aaya hua sansar hai.

Jaise koi vyakti khidki se bahar dekh raha ho. Khidki se aasman ka ek hissa dikhta hai, sadak ka ek hissa dikhta hai, kuch ped dikhte hain. Jo dikhta hai, vah galat nahi. Lekin poora bhi nahi. Khidki ka aakar drishya ko seemit kar raha hai.

Isi tarah hamari indriyan anubhav ki khidkiyan hain.

Vah kuch dikhati hain, kuch nahi dikhati. Vah kuch sunati hain, kuch nahi sunati. Vah sansar ka ek roop hamare saamne laati hain.

Phir man us anubhav ko naam deta hai, arth deta hai, kahani deta hai. Ye naam, arth aur kahani milkar "mera sansar" banate hain.

Adhyatma science ka virodh nahi karta. Vah sirf ek simple baat dikhata hai - anubhav aur antim satya alag ho sakte hain. Jo humein dikh raha hai, vah hamari jaanne ki vyavastha se hokar aaya hai. Use turant antim satya maan lena jaldbazi ho sakti hai.

Jab yeh dikhne lagta hai ki sansar indriyon aur man se chhan kar aata hai, tab pakad thodi dheeli hone lagti hai. Hum har anubhav ko antim faisla nahi mante. Hum ruk kar dekhte hain.

"Yeh mujhe aisa dikh raha hai. Par kya yahi poora satya hai?"

"Yeh ghatna mujhe bhaari lag rahi hai. Par kya isme mere man ki vyakhya bhi judi hai?"

"Yeh vyakti mujhe aisa lagta hai. Par kya main use apni yaadon se dekh raha hoon?"

Aise prashn dekhne ki gehrai badhate hain.

sections.title: Sapne ka Gehra Udaharan
sections.content:
Pehle adhyay mein humne sapne ka halka sa sanket dekha tha. Ab use thoda aur gehrai se samajhte hain.

Raat mein sapna aata hai. Sapne mein ek poori duniya hoti hai. Vahan log hote hain, jagah hoti hai, ghatnayein hoti hain. Kabhi hum bhaag rahe hote hain, kabhi kisi se baat kar rahe hote hain, kabhi dar rahe hote hain, kabhi khush hote hain. Sapne mein samay bhi lagta hai. Lagta hai jaise bahut kuch ho raha hai.

Sapne ke bheetar vah sab sach lagta hai.

Agar sapne mein koi tumhara peecha kar raha hai, to dar sach lagta hai. Hriday tez dhadak sakta hai. Sharir mein tanav aa sakta hai. Agar sapne mein tum kisi priya vyakti se milte ho, to khushi sach lagti hai. Agar sapne mein kuch kho jata hai, to dukh sach lagta hai.

Us samay sapna sirf imagination jaisa nahi lagta. Vah anubhav mein real lagta hai.

Phir jagne par kya hota hai?

Tum dekhte ho - sharir bistar par tha. Kamra wahi hai. Sapna chala gaya. Sapne ki jagah, log, ghatnayein, dar, bhaagna - sab us swapn-avastha tak sach the. Jagne par unki sthiti badal gayi.

Dhyan rahe, hum yeh nahi keh rahe ki jagta hua sansar bilkul sapne jaisa hi hai. Abhi aisa nishkarsh nahi banana. Hum sirf ek baat dekh rahe hain - kisi avastha ke bheetar anubhav bahut real lag sakta hai, lekin baad mein uski reality ki samajh badal sakti hai.

Sapne ke andar sapna sach tha. Jagne par vah antim sach nahi nikla.

To ab prashn uthta hai:

Kya yeh possible hai ki jagte hue sansar ko bhi hum jitna final aur atal satya mante hain, vah utna final na ho?

Kya yeh possible hai ki yeh sansar anubhav mein sach ho, vyavahar mein upyogi ho, par antim satya na ho?

Kya yeh possible hai ki saakshi ki drishti se iska swaroop kuch aur dikhe?

In prashnon ko abhi answer mat banao. Inhe bheetar rehne do.

Sapne ka example sansar ko nakarne ke liye nahi hai. Yeh sirf itna dikhane ke liye hai ki anubhav ki reality aur antim satya ki reality alag ho sakti hai.

Jab tak hum sapna dekh rahe hote hain, sapne ka sansar hamare liye real hota hai. Jab hum jagte hain, drishti badalti hai. Adhyatma bhi koi belief thopta nahi; vah drishti jagata hai.

sections.title: Sansar Ko Nakaarna Nahi, Dekhna Hai
sections.content:
Yahan ek bahut zaroori savdhani hai.

Is adhyay ka uddeshya yeh kehna nahi hai ki sansar jhooth hai, isliye use importance mat do. Aisi samajh adhoori hogi.

Sansar mein sharir hai, sambandh hain, zimmedariyan hain, karm hain, sukh-dukh hain. Inhe halka lena sadhana nahi hai. Koi bhookha hai to bhojan dena hoga. Koi dukhi hai to samvedana rakhni hogi. Sharir bimaar hai to dekhbhal karni hogi. Sambandhon mein satya aur prem rakhna hoga.

Adhyatma sansar se bhaagna nahi sikhata. Vah sansar ko sahi drishti se dekhna sikhata hai.

Jab hum sansar ko antim satya maan lete hain, to usme poori tarah bandh jaate hain. Jab hum sansar ko vyarth maan kar nakarte hain, to samvedanheen ho sakte hain. Lekin jab hum sansar ko anubhav ke roop mein dekhte hain, tab usme rehte hue bhi spashtata sambhav hoti hai.

Yahi madhya disha hai - na andhi pakad, na kathor nakar.

Jaise ek natak dekhte samay tum ro bhi sakte ho, hans bhi sakte ho, kahani se jud bhi sakte ho. Lekin bheetar kahin jaante ho ki yeh natak hai. Yeh jaanna natak ke anubhav ko khatam nahi karta; use sahi sthan deta hai.

Sansar ke saath bhi saadhak ko dheere-dheere yahi paripakvata seekhni hai.

Jeevan jeena hai. Par usme khona nahi hai. Sambandh nibhane hain. Par unse antim pehchan nahi banani hai. Ghatnayein hongi. Par unhe antim satya ki mohar nahi deni hai.

Abhi hum isi disha ki tayari kar rahe hain.

sections.title: Anubhav aur Satya ke Beech ki Doori
sections.content:
Ab tak humne kuch saral baatein dekhi.

Sansar bahut real lagta hai. Lekin sabko sansar ek jaisa nahi dikhta. Hum sansar ko indriyon aur man se hokar jaante hain. Indriyan seemit hain. Man anubhav ko arth aur kahani deta hai. Sapne mein bhi ek duniya sach lagti hai, par jagne par uski sthiti badal jaati hai.

In sab baaton se ek shant jigyasa paida hoti hai.

Kya jo mujhe dikh raha hai, wahi antim satya hai?

Ya yeh anubhav hai, jo mere dekhne ke sadhanon se bana hai?

Kya sansar ka anubhav man aur indriyon se hokar mere saamne aa raha hai?

Aur agar aisa hai, to is poori vyavastha ko samajhne ki koi bhasha honi chahiye.

Advaita Vedanta mein isi disha mein ek bahut gehra shabd aata hai - Maya.

Maya ko samjhe bina sansar ki prakriti ko theek se nahi samjha ja sakta. Aur sansar ko samjhe bina saadhak ki apni pehchan poori tarah clear nahi hoti.

Ab hum isi shabd ko kholenge - dheere-dheere, saral bhasha mein, jeevan ke anubhav se jodkar.

sections.title: Aaj ke Liye Abhyas
sections.content:
Aaj kisi ek sadharan vastu ya ghatna ko dhyan se dekho. Yeh cup ho sakta hai, ped ho sakta hai, sadak par chalti bheed ho sakti hai, baarish ho sakti hai, koi awaaz ho sakti hai, ya kisi vyakti ka chehra ho sakta hai.

Use dekhte hue dheere se pucho:

"Yeh mujhe kaise dikh raha hai?"

"Kya yeh sabko aise hi dikhta hoga?"

"Is anubhav mein bahar ki vastu kitni hai, aur mere man ki yaad, pasand, napasand ya arth kitna jud raha hai?"

Answer banane ki jaldi mat karo. Bas dekho.

Sansar ko pehli baar ki tarah dekhna shuru karo.

sections.title: Ab Maya Ko Samajhna Hai
sections.content:
Humne sansar ko ek naye dhang se dekhna shuru kiya. Humne dekha ki sansar bahut real lagta hai. Rang, roop, awaaz, log, ghatnayein, samay aur sthan - sab kuch itna thos lagta hai ki hum use natural roop se antim satya maan lete hain.

Humne yeh bhi dekha ki ek hi drishya sabko ek jaisa nahi dikhai deta. Ek hi baarish kisi ko anand deti hai, kisi ko pareshani. Ek hi vaakya kisi ko chot deta hai, kisi ke liye normal hota hai. Humne dekha ki sansar ko hum indriyon aur man ke madhyam se jaante hain. Aur sapne ke udaharan se yeh bhi dekha ki jo anubhav mein real lagta hai, zaroori nahi ki vah antim satya bhi ho.

Ab hum us shabd ki or aate hain jo is poore rahasya ki or sanket karta hai.

Vah shabd hai - Maya.

Maya ko samajhna sansar ko nakaarna nahi hai. Maya ko samajhna sansar ko sahi sthan par dekhna hai. Jab Maya samajh mein aane lagti hai, to sansar gayab nahi hota. Sansar ki pakad badalne lagti hai. Jo pehle antim satya jaisa lagta tha, ab ek gehre rahasya ki tarah dikhne lagta hai.

sections.title: Maya Kya Hai?
sections.content:
Is course mein Maya ka arth hai - vah shakti jiske kaaran ek hi advaita satya anek naam, roop, sambandh, ghatna aur anubhav ke roop mein dikhai deta hai.

Dhyan se samjho.

Antim satya ek hai. Lekin anubhav mein anekta dikhai deti hai. Main alag, tum alag. Yeh ghar alag, vah ghar alag. Yeh desh alag, vah desh alag. Yeh sukh alag, vah dukh alag. Yeh mera, vah tumhara. Yeh achha, vah bura. Yeh apna, vah paraya.

Yeh poora bhed sansar mein chalta hai. Vyavahar mein iski zaroorat bhi hai. Agar tumhara ghar aur kisi doosre ka ghar alag na maana jaye, to samaj chal hi nahi payega. Agar mata-pita, mitra, teacher, doctor, dukandar, kisan - in sab roles ka bhed na rahe, to daily life impossible ho jayegi.

Isliye Maya ka arth yeh nahi hai ki sansar bilkul hai hi nahi.

Maya jhooth nahi hai jaise koi vastu bilkul maujood hi na ho. Agar tum table se takraoge, to sharir ko chot lag sakti hai. Agar sharir ko bhojan na mile, to bhookh lagegi. Agar koi kathor shabd bole, to man mein reaction uth sakta hai. Isliye vyavahar mein jagat ka prabhav hai.

Lekin Maya antim satya bhi nahi hai.

Maya mein naam aur roop hain. Anubhav hain. Bhed hain. Ghatnayein hain. Lekin jab gyaan ki drishti khulti hai, to spasht hone lagta hai ki in sabki apni alag, final, independent satta nahi hai. Yeh kisi gehre aadhar par prakat hain.

Jaise lehar dikhai deti hai, par lehar jal se alag koi independent vastu nahi. Lehar ka naam hai, aakar hai, gati hai, par uska saar jal hi hai. Lehar ko dekhkar agar koi jal ko bhool jaye, to bhram hai. Jal ko dekhkar lehar ko nakar de, to bhi adhoori drishti hai.

Maya ka arth isi beech ki samajh hai.

Dikhta hai, isliye nakaarna nahi.

Antim nahi hai, isliye khona nahi.

sections.title: Sona aur Aabhushan
sections.content:
Maya ko samajhne ke liye ek simple example lo - sona aur aabhushan.

Ek hi sone se anguthi ban sakti hai. Usi sone se haar ban sakta hai. Usi sone se kangan ban sakta hai. Usi sone se sikka ban sakta hai.

Vyavahar mein hum kehte hain:

Yeh anguthi hai.

Yeh haar hai.

Yeh kangan hai.

Yeh sikka hai.

Naam alag hain. Roop alag hain. Upyog alag ho sakta hai. Kabhi-kabhi kala, weight aur design ke hisab se value bhi alag dikhti hai. Lekin mool padarth kya hai?

Sona.

Agar anguthi pighla kar kangan bana di jaye, to naam badal gaya, roop badal gaya. Lekin sona wahi raha. Anguthi ka naam aaya aur gaya. Kangan ka naam aaya. Kal kangan bhi pighal sakta hai. Roop badalte rahe, par sona bana raha.

Ab sansar ko is tarah dekho.

Naam aur roop lagatar badal rahe hain. Sharir badalta hai. Ghar banta hai, tootata hai. Sambandh bante hain, badalte hain. Samaj badalta hai. Vichar badalte hain. Vastu banti hain, purani hoti hain. Naam-roop ke level par sab chal raha hai.

Maya naam aur roop ka yahi khel hai.

Ek hi aadhar anek roopon mein dikhai deta hai. Lekin saadhak naam aur roop mein itna ulajh jata hai ki aadhar bhool jata hai.

Yahan savdhani rakhni hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki anguthi ka vyavaharic mahatva nahi. Anguthi ko anguthi ki tarah use kiya jayega. Haar ko haar ki tarah. Kangan ko kangan ki tarah. Vyavahar mein naam aur roop chalte rahenge.

Lekin samajh mein yeh spasht rahega ki naam aur roop badalte hain; mool padarth ek hi hai.

Advaita ki drishti mein saadhak dheere-dheere sansar ko isi tarah dekhna seekhta hai. Bhed dikhte hain, par bheetar ekta ki jhalak bhi rehti hai.

sections.title: Indradhanush
sections.content:
Ab ek aur example lo - indradhanush.

Baarish ke baad aasman mein indradhanush dikhai deta hai. Door se vah kitna sundar lagta hai. Saat rangon ka ek bridge jaisa. Bachcha use dekhkar khush ho jata hai. Kavi use dekhkar kavita likh sakta hai. Koi photo kheenchta hai. Lagta hai jaise aasman mein sach-much rangon ki koi patti latak rahi hai.

Lekin jab hum samajhte hain ki indradhanush kaise banta hai, to pata chalta hai ki vah roshni aur paani ki boondon ke vishesh sambandh se dikhai deta hai. Rang dikhte hain, par vah kisi thos patti ki tarah aasman mein latke nahi hote. Indradhanush anubhav mein hai, sundar hai, prabhavshali hai, par pakadne jao to pakad mein nahi aata.

Kya iska matlab hai ki indradhanush jhooth hai?

Nahi. Tumne use dekha. Usne anand diya. Vah anubhav mein aaya.

Kya iska matlab hai ki indradhanush koi thos vastu hai jise haath mein liya ja sakta hai?

Nahi. Vah waise nahi hai jaise door se dikh raha tha.

Maya ko samajhne mein yeh example upyogi hai.

Sansar bhi anubhav mein aata hai. Rang, roop, sambandh, ghatnayein - sab dikhte hain. Unka prabhav bhi hota hai. Par jab drishti gehri hoti hai, to dikhai deta hai ki jo itna thos lag raha tha, vah naam, roop, indriya, man aur aadhar ke sambandh se bana hua anubhav hai.

Isse sansar ki sundarta kam nahi hoti. Aashcharya badhta hai.

Maya dosh nahi hai. Maya ek rahasya hai. Maya vah adbhut vyavastha hai jisme ek satya anek roopon mein khilta hua dikhai deta hai.

sections.title: Na Poori Tarah Satya, Na Poori Tarah Asatya
sections.content:
Ab Maya ki sabse subtle baat ko simple bhasha mein samjhte hain.

Maya ko poori tarah satya nahi keh sakte, kyunki Maya mein jo dikhai deta hai, vah badalta rehta hai. Naam badalte hain, roop badalte hain, anubhav badalte hain. Jo aaj hai, kal waise nahi rahega. Sharir badalta hai, sambandh badalte hain, samaj badalta hai, vichar badalte hain, bhavnaen badalti hain. Jo badalta rehta hai, use antim satya nahi kaha ja sakta.

Lekin Maya ko poori tarah asatya bhi nahi keh sakte, kyunki vah anubhav mein dikhai deti hai. Uska prabhav hota hai. Sansar mein jeena padta hai. Bhookh lagti hai. Prem hota hai. Dukh hota hai. Zimmedariyan hoti hain. Karuna ki zaroorat hoti hai. Isliye yeh bhi nahi kaha ja sakta ki kuch hai hi nahi.

To phir Maya kya hai?

Maya anubhav mein prabhavshali hai, par antim satya nahi hai.

Ek jadugar ka show dekho. Stage par vah kuch aisa dikhata hai ki audience hairan ho jaati hai. Koi vastu gayab ho jaati hai, koi achanak prakat ho jaati hai, koi scene impossible lagta hai. Dekhne wale ke liye us moment mein anubhav sach hai. Aankhon ne dekha, man chakit hua.

Lekin bheetar kahin jaante hain - koi trick hai. Jo dikh raha hai, vah apne aap mein final truth nahi. Uske peeche koi arrangement, koi skill, koi chhupa hua karan hai.

Jab tak trick samajh mein nahi aati, hum poori tarah chakit rehte hain. Jab samajh mein aa jaati hai, to aashcharya ka roop badal jata hai. Scene dikhta hai, par pakad kam ho jaati hai.

Maya bhi kuch aisi hi hai. Yeh ordinary magic nahi hai, par example se baat samajh aati hai.

Jab tak Maya samajh mein nahi aati, sansar antim satya jaisa lagta hai.

Jab Maya samajh mein aane lagti hai, sansar dikhai deta hai, par uski pakad dheeli hone lagti hai.

Gyaan mein Maya apni independent satta kho deti hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki aankhen band ho gayi aur sansar dikhna band ho gaya. Iska matlab hai ki saadhak ab sansar ko antim satya maan kar usme khota nahi. Naam aur roop prakat hain, par unka aadhar kuch gehra hai.

sections.title: Maya ka Vyavaharic Prabhav: Naam aur Roop ka Khel
sections.content:
Ab Maya ko roz ke jeevan mein dekho.

Hum kehte hain - "mera ghar" aur "tumhara ghar." Vyavahar mein yeh bhed zaroori hai. Lekin thoda gehrai se dekho. Dono gharon mein eent, cement, lakdi, loha jaise padarth hain. Naam aur ownership badal gayi, par padarth ki prakriti alag nahi ho gayi.

Hum kehte hain - "mera desh" aur "tumhara desh." Vyavahar mein desh ki seema mahatvapurn hai. Samaj, law, bhasha, culture - sabka apna sthan hai. Lekin dharti ki drishti se dekho to bhoomi ek hi prithvi ka bhaag hai. Manushya rekha kheenchta hai, naam deta hai, vyavastha banata hai. Vyavahar mein yeh sab zaroori hai. Par gehri drishti se dharti khud ko tukdon mein nahi baantti.

Hum kehte hain - "mera sharir", "tumhara sharir." Vyavahar mein sharir alag hain. Dekhbhal bhi alag karni hai. Dard bhi har sharir mein apne dhang se anubhav hota hai. Lekin sharir ko banane wale tattva prakriti se hi aate hain - bhojan, jal, hawa, mitti, prakash. Jo sharir aaj "mera" kehlata hai, vah bhi prakriti ki chalti hui vyavastha hai.

Hum kehte hain - "mera vichar", "tumhara vichar." Lekin vichar bhi bhasha, sanskar, samaj, smriti aur anubhav se bante hain. Kitni baatein jo hum apni mante hain, vah humne parivar, samaj, books, education aur jeevan se li hoti hain.

Yahi naam aur roop ka khel hai.

Naam diya - bhed bana.

Roop dekha - pehchan bani.

Kahani jodi - "mera" aur "tumhara" mazboot hua.

Vyavahar mein yeh sab chalna chahiye. Agar ghar tumhara hai, to uski zimmedari tumhari hai. Agar kisi doosre ka ghar hai, to uska samman karna hai. Agar kisi vyakti ki seema hai, to uska aadar karna hai.

Maya ko samajhne ka arth vyavaharic bhed ko mitana nahi hai. Iska arth hai ki bheetar yeh clarity rahe - bhed vyavahar mein hain; gehri samajh mein ekta hai.

Saadhak dono ko saath rakhna seekhta hai.

Vyavahar mein bhed ka samman.

Samajh mein ekta ki pehchan.

Yahi paripakvata hai.

sections.title: Maya Dosh Nahi, Dwar Hai
sections.content:
Kai baar saadhak Maya shabd sunkar sochta hai ki Maya koi buri cheez hai. Jaise Maya koi dosh ho, koi shatru ho, kuch aisa jise turant mita dena chahiye.

Yeh samajh adhoori hai.

Maya ke bina sansar ka anubhav nahi hota. Naam, roop, sambandh, seekh, sadhana, guru, shishya, prem, karuna - yeh sab bhi isi anubhav-kshetra mein aate hain. Agar jagat hi na dikhe, to sadhana ka marg bhi kaise dikhega?

Isliye Maya ko ghrina ki drishti se nahi, samajh ki drishti se dekhna hai.

Maya bandhati tab hai jab hum use antim satya maan lete hain.

Maya mukti ka dwar ban sakti hai jab hum uske paar aadhar ko dekhna shuru karte hain.

Jaise painter ek white canvas par anek rangon se chitra banata hai. Chitra mein pahad hai, nadi hai, aasman hai, log hain, ped hain. Dekhne wala kahani mein kho sakta hai. Lekin agar vah dhyan se dekhe, to samajhta hai ki sab rangon ka khel hai, aur sab ek hi canvas par prakat hai.

Chitra ko nakarna nahi hai. Uski sundarta dekhni hai. Lekin canvas ko bhoolna bhi nahi hai.

Maya bhi aisi hi hai. Naam aur roop ke chitra prakat hain. Saadhak unhe dekhta hai, unme vyavahar karta hai, unse seekhta hai. Lekin dheere-dheere aadhar ko bhoolna kam ho jata hai.

sections.title: Maya aur Avidya ka Chhota Antar
sections.content:
Yahan ek baat halke se clear kar lein, taaki aage confusion na bane.

Maya jagat-star par hai. Iska arth hai - ek satya anek naam aur roop ke roop mein dikhai deta hai. Yeh poori appearance ki vyavastha hai.

Avidya vyakti-star par hai. Iska arth hai - is dikhai dene wali vyavastha ke andar saadhak sharir-man ko "main" maan leta hai.

Saral bhasha mein:

Maya sansar ko anek roopon mein dikhati hai.

Avidya kehti hai - "main isi sharir-man tak seemit hoon."

Is adhyay mein hamara main focus Maya par hai. Avidya par gehrai se baat aage ke adhyayon mein hogi. Abhi itna samajhna kaafi hai ki Maya drishya ki vyavastha hai, aur Avidya us drishya mein galat pehchan banana hai.

sections.title: Maya Samajhne se Jeevan Kaise Badalta Hai
sections.content:
Jab Maya ki samajh shuru hoti hai, to zaroori nahi ki jeevan bahar se turant badal jaye. Ghar wahi rahega, kaam wahi rahega, log wahi rahenge, zimmedariyan wahi rahengi. Lekin dekhne ki drishti badalne lagegi.

Pehle jahan sirf bhed dikhta tha, wahan kabhi-kabhi ekta ki jhalak aayegi.

Pehle jahan har naam aur roop final lagta tha, wahan ab uski asthirta dikhegi.

Pehle jahan "mera" aur "tumhara" bahut kathor lagta tha, wahan ab thodi komalta aa sakti hai.

Pehle jahan kisi ghatna ko antim satya maan kar man toot jata tha, wahan ab bheetar se prashn uth sakta hai - "Kya yeh bhi naam-roop ka badalta hua drishya hai?"

Yeh samajh jeevan se bhaagne ki nahi hai. Yeh jeevan mein jagne ki hai.

Maya ko samajhne wala saadhak adhik zimmedar ho sakta hai, kyunki vyavahar mein har karm ka mahatva hai. Saath hi vah bheetar kam bandhata hai, kyunki vah jaanta hai ki naam aur roop antim satya nahi hain.

sections.title: Aaj ke Liye Abhyas
sections.content:
Aaj din mein kisi bhi teen vastu ya sambandh ko dekhkar naam aur roop ka khel pehchano.

Ek cup ko dekho aur pucho - "Naam cup hai, roop cup jaisa hai, par padarth kya hai?"

Ek ghar ko dekho aur pucho - "Naam is ghar ka alag hai, par ise banane wale tattva kahan se aaye?"

Kisi vyakti ko dekhkar pucho - "Main ise naam, role aur purane anubhav se dekh raha hoon, ya abhi sach mein dekh raha hoon?"

Phir dheere se yeh vaakya yaad karo:

"Naam aur roop badalte hain, par koi gehra aadhar hai jis par sab prakat hai."

Answer banane ki jaldi mat karo. Bas naam aur roop ko dekho. Yahin se Maya ki samajh anubhav mein utarna shuru hoti hai.

sections.title: Maya Samajhne ka Matlab Sansar Chhodna Nahi
sections.content:
Ab ek natural prashn uthta hai:

Agar yeh sab Maya hai, to kya humein sansar mein jeena chhod dena chahiye?

Kya ghar, kaam, parivar, sambandh aur samaj ko chhod dena chahiye?

Kya "sab ek hai" kehkar sab vyavaharic bhed mita dene chahiye?

Nahi.

Maya ko samajhna sansar se bhaagne ka nimantran nahi hai. Maya ko samajhna sansar mein adhik spashtata, karuna aur santulan se jeene ka nimantran hai.

Saadhak sansar ko chhodta nahi. Vah sansar ko sahi sthan par rakhna seekhta hai. Vah jeevan se muh nahi modta. Vah jeevan ko gehri drishti se dekhta hai.

Maya isliye nahi samjhi jaati ki hum sookhe ya careless ho jayein. Maya isliye samjhi jaati hai ki hum andhi pakad mein na bandhe rahein.

sections.title: Jagat Ko Jhooth Mat Samjho - Vah Badalne Wala Hai
sections.content:
Yahan ek bahut common galatfahmi ko sudharna zaroori hai.

Jab saadhak pehli baar sunta hai, "sab Maya hai", to man galat arth le sakta hai. Vah soch sakta hai - "Agar sab Maya hai, to kuch bhi matter nahi karta. Sambandh jhooth, kaam jhooth, dukh jhooth, prem jhooth."

Yeh sahi samajh nahi hai.

Vyavahar mein jagat ka mahatva hai. Sharir ko bhojan chahiye. Bimaar vyakti ko treatment chahiye. Parivar mein zimmedari nibhani hoti hai. Samaj mein satya, nyay aur karuna ki zaroorat hoti hai. Kisi ke dukh ko dekhkar yeh kehna ki "sab Maya hai" aur aage badh jana, adhyatma nahi hai. Vah samvedanheenata hai.

Is course ke liye baat simple rakho:

Jagat anubhav mein hai.

Jagat vyavahar mein mahatvapurn hai.

Lekin jagat badalne wala hai.

Isliye use final, independent aur unchanging truth maan lena bhool hai.

Log aksar sukshma shiksha ko "duniya jhooth hai" ke roop mein samajh lete hain. Iske bajay ise aise samjho: duniya dikhai deti hai, anubhav hoti hai, vyavahar mein prabhav rakhti hai, par apne aap mein final aur achal nahi hai.

Saral bhasha mein:

Jagat jhooth nahi hai.

Jagat anitya hai - badalne wala, asthayi.

Jagat anubhav mein hai, par antim satya nahi.

Yeh antar bahut zaroori hai.

Agar jagat ko jhooth maan liya, to saadhak jeevan se kat sakta hai.

Agar jagat ko antim satya maan liya, to saadhak usme bandh sakta hai.

Agar jagat ko badalne wala aur Maya ke roop mein samjha, to saadhak usme rehte hue bhi clear reh sakta hai.

sections.title: Sadhana aur Sansarik Jeevan Saath Chal Sakte Hain
sections.content:
Sadhana aur sansarik jeevan ek-doosre ke dushman nahi hain.

Ek saadhak job kar sakta hai. Business kar sakta hai. Parivar chala sakta hai. Bachchon ki dekhbhal kar sakta hai. Mata-pita ki seva kar sakta hai. Samaj mein apna kaam kar sakta hai. Aur in sab ke saath bheetar Maya ki samajh bhi rakh sakta hai.

Yeh koi contradiction nahi hai.

Maan lo ek saadhak kisi kaam mein poori mehnat karta hai. Plan banata hai, shrama karta hai, imandari se effort karta hai. Phir bhi result uske hisab se nahi aata. Aam taur par anubhavkarta turant kehta hai - "Main fail ho gaya. Meri value kam ho gayi. Log kya sochenge?"

Lekin Maya ki kuch samajh wala saadhak thoda ruk sakta hai.

Vah dekh sakta hai - "Result aaya hai. Man mein dukh aur nirasha uth rahi hai. Sharir bhaari lag raha hai. Lekin success-failure naam-roop ke kshetra ki ghatna hai. Yeh mere antim swaroop ka faisla nahi hai."

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki vah kaam chhod dega. Vah apni galti dekhega, seekhega, phir prayas karega. Par bheetar poori tarah tootega nahi.

Yahi Maya ki samajh ka practical laabh hai.

Ek aur example lo.

Ghar mein koi kathor bol deta hai. Man ko chot lagti hai. Anubhavkarta kehta hai - "Usne mere saath aisa kiya. Ab main bhi jawab doonga." Lekin saadhak agar thoda sajag hai, to dekh sakta hai - "Yeh naam-roop ka sambandh hai. Yeh man ki reaction hai. Mujhe vyavahar mein clarity rakhni hai, par bheetar is chot ko apni final identity nahi banana hai."

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki anyay sehna hai. Iska arth hai ki reaction andhi na ho. Jo kehna hai, clear kehna. Jo boundary rakhni hai, rakhni. Jo zimmedari nibhani hai, nibhani. Par bheetar na bhoolna ki ghatna badalne wali hai, man ki lehar badalne wali hai, aur saakshi is sabko jaan raha hai.

Sadhana jeevan ke bahar nahi hai. Sadhana jeevan ke beech hai.

sections.title: Karuna aur Maya
sections.content:
Ek aur galatfahmi hai.

Kuch log sochte hain ki agar "sab Maya hai", to vyakti indifferent ho jayega. Use doosron ke dukh se farq nahi padega. Vah kahega, "Yeh to sab naam-roop ka khel hai," aur aage badh jayega.

Yeh sahi samajh nahi hai.

Maya ki sahi samajh karuna ko kam nahi karti, karuna ko gehra karti hai.

Kyon?

Jab saadhak sirf naam aur roop dekhta hai, to alagav bahut strong lagta hai. "Main alag hoon, tum alag ho. Mera dukh mera hai, tumhara dukh tumhara hai. Mera ghar mera hai, tumhara jeevan tumhara hai."

Lekin jab saadhak dekhta hai ki naam aur roop alag hain, par aadhar ek hai, to alagav ki kathorta thodi pighalti hai.

Sona aur aabhushan ka example yaad karo.

Anguthi, haar aur kangan alag dikhte hain. Naam alag, roop alag, upyog alag. Lekin mool mein sona ek hai. Jab yeh samajh gehri hoti hai, to ek aabhushan doosre se poori tarah paraya nahi lagta.

Isi tarah sharir alag hain, man alag hain, jeevan ki kahaniyan alag hain. Lekin jis chetana mein anubhav jaana ja raha hai, jis astitva mein sab prakat hai, uska aadhar alag-alag nahi hai.

Isliye saadhak jab kisi doosre ke dukh ko dekhta hai, to vah sirf "uska dukh" nahi dekhta. Vah dukh ki usi lehar ko pehchanta hai jise usne apne jeevan mein bhi jaana hai. Kahani alag ho sakti hai, par dukh ka rang milta-julta hai.

Yahin se karuna janm leti hai.

Karuna ka arth daya dikhana nahi. Karuna ka arth hai - alagav kam hona. Doosre ki peeda ko halka na lena. Vyavahar mein sahayata karna. Hriday mein komalta rakhna.

Agar koi bhookha hai, to bhojan dena Maya ki samajh ke viruddh nahi. Yeh Maya ke beech sahi karm hai.

Agar koi dukhi hai, to use sunna sansar mein phasna nahi. Yeh ekta ki jhalak se uthi karuna hai.

Agar anyay ho raha hai, to satya ke saath khada hona Advaita ke viruddh nahi. Yeh vyavahar mein dharma hai.

Maya ki samajh udasinata nahi laati. Vah alagav ki kathor deewaron ko naram karti hai.

sections.title: Zimmedari aur Bhed ka Samman
sections.content:
Santulan ko ek baar phir yaad kar lo.

Samajh mein ekta.

Vyavahar mein bhed.

Bheetar yeh pehchan ho sakti hai ki sab ek hi aadhar par prakat hai. Phir bhi vyavahar mein tumhara sharir tumhari dekhbhal chahta hai. Tumhara ghar tumhari zimmedari hai. Tumhara kaam tumhara shrama maangta hai. Tumhare sambandh satya, prem aur clarity chahte hain.

Agar koi saadhak kahe, "Sab ek hai, isliye mujhe kisi zimmedari ki zaroorat nahi," to yeh samajh nahi, bhram hai.

Sagar ek hai, par lehren alag-alag dikh sakti hain. Har lehar ki disha, aakar aur samay alag ho sakta hai. Isi tarah aadhar ek hone par bhi vyavahar mein bhed ko nakara nahi jata.

Maya ko samajhne wala saadhak do baaton ko saath rakhta hai:

Bahar - clear karm, zimmedari aur maryada.

Bheetar - ekta ki shant pehchan.

Apne parivar ki dekhbhal karo.

Apna kaam imandari se karo.

Apne sharir ka dhyan rakho.

Samaj mein jo uchit ho, vah karo.

Sambandhon mein satya aur karuna rakho.

Lekin bheetar yaad rahe ki yeh sab naam-roop ke badalte hue kshetra mein ho raha hai. Isliye inmein poori tarah khona nahi hai.

Zimmedari nibhani hai.

Bandhan nahi banana hai.

sections.title: Maya ki Samajh se Pakad Dheeli Hoti Hai
sections.content:
Maya samajhne se sansar gayab nahi hota. Lekin sansar ki pakad dheeli ho sakti hai.

Pehle koi apmaan hua to man kai din tak usi mein phansa rehta tha. Ab wahi ghatna aaye, dukh bhi uthe, par bheetar thodi jagah bache - "Yeh man ki lehar hai, yeh bhi badlegi."

Pehle success mili to ahankar turant kehta tha - "Main bahut bada hoon." Ab success aaye, anand bhi ho, par bheetar clarity rahe - "Yeh result aaya hai, yeh bhi naam-roop ke kshetra mein hai."

Pehle haani hui to lagta tha sab khatam ho gaya. Ab haani ho, dukh bhi ho, par bheetar se prashn uth sakta hai - "Kya mera poora astitva is ghatna par depend karta hai?"

Yahi pakad dheeli hona hai.

Saadhak pathar nahi ban jata. Vah samvedanheen nahi hota. Balki vah adhik sajag hota hai. Vah dukh ko bhi dekhta hai, sukh ko bhi dekhta hai. Lekin har anubhav ko final truth ki mohar nahi deta.

Isse jeevan mein ek nayi komal swatantrata aati hai.

Sukh aaye, use prem se anubhav karo.

Dukh aaye, use imandari se dekho.

Kaam aaye, use zimmedari se karo.

Sambandh aayein, unhe satya aur karuna se nibhao.

Par bheetar yaad rakho - naam aur roop badalte hain. Aadhar achal hai.

sections.title: Is Adhyay ka Saar
sections.content:
Ab is adhyay ki yatra ko sankshipt mein samet lete hain.

Pehle humne sansar ko dekha. Humne dekha ki sansar bahut real lagta hai - rang, roop, awaaz, log, ghatnayein, samay aur sthan. Phir humne prashn uthaya ki kya sabko sansar ek jaisa dikhta hai. Humne dekha ki ek hi baarish, ek hi gaana, ek hi ghatna alag-alag logon ko alag anubhav deti hai. Isse yeh spasht hua ki sansar ka anubhav sirf bahar se nahi banta; usme indriyan, man, smriti aur drishti bhi shamil hain.

Humne yeh bhi dekha ki hum sansar ko seedhe nahi, indriyon aur man ke madhyam se jaante hain. Indriyan seemit hain, man arth jodta hai. Sapne ke udaharan se prashn utha ki jo anubhav mein sach lagta hai, zaroori nahi ki vah antim satya bhi ho.

Phir humne Maya ko samjha. Maya vah shakti hai jiske kaaran ek hi advaita satya anek naam, roop aur anubhav mein dikhai deta hai. Humne sona aur aabhushan ka example dekha - naam aur roop alag, par mool padarth ek. Humne indradhanush dekha - anubhav mein sundar aur prabhavshali, par thos vastu ki tarah pakad mein nahi aane wala. Humne samjha ki Maya na poori tarah satya hai, na poori tarah asatya. Vah anubhav mein prabhavshali hai, par antim satya nahi.

Aur ab is antim bhaag mein humne dekha ki Maya ko samajhna jeevan se bhaagna nahi hai. Yeh jeevan ko sahi drishti se jeena hai. Sansar mein rehna hai, zimmedari nibhani hai, karuna rakhni hai, vyavaharic bhed ka samman rakhna hai - par bheetar yaad rakhna hai ki naam aur roop antim satya nahi hain.

Yahi Adhyay 2 ki mool disha hai.

sections.title: Agle Adhyay ki Or
sections.content:
Ab tak saadhak ne do dishaon mein dekhna shuru kiya hai.

Pehle adhyay mein usne bheetar dekha. Sharir, man, anubhavkarta aur saakshi ki jaanch ki. Usne dekha ki vah sirf sharir-man nahi, balki in sabko jaanne wali shant upasthiti ki or laut sakta hai.

Is adhyay mein usne bahar ki or dekha. Sansar, anubhav, indriyan, man aur Maya ki jaanch ki. Usne samajhna shuru kiya ki jagat naam aur roop ka badalta hua drishya hai - anubhav mein hai, vyavahar mein mahatvapurn hai, par antim satya nahi.

Ab agla kadam natural hai.

Maya ke beech rehte hue saakshi-bhav kaise jeevit rakha jaye?

Yahi agle adhyay ka vishay hoga - Saakshi Bhav: Vistar se.

Us adhyay mein hum saakshi ko aur gehrai se samjhenge. Hum dekhenge ki sirf shant baithne mein nahi, balki chalte hue, bolte hue, kaam karte hue, sambandh nibhate hue, success-failure ke beech, sukh-dukh ke beech - saakshi-bhav kaise yaad rakha jaye.

Kyuki saakshi-bhav sirf ek idea nahi hai. Vah jeevan mein baar-baar lautne ki disha hai.

Maya jagat ko dikhati hai.

Saakshi jagat ko jaanta hai.

Saadhak ki yatra hai - dikhte hue jagat mein rehte hue jaanne wali upasthiti ko na bhoolna.

sections.title: Samapan
sections.content:
Sansar sundar hai.

Isme rang hain, dhwaniyan hain, sambandh hain, rituyein hain, janm hai, badlav hai, prem hai, seekh hai, karuna hai, sadhana hai. Ise nakarna nahi hai.

Lekin sansar badalta hai. Jo aata hai, jata bhi hai. Jo banta hai, badalta bhi hai. Jo priya hai, vah bhi samay ke saath roop badalta hai. Jo dukhad hai, vah bhi sthayi nahi rehta.

Maya ko samajhna yahi hai - sansar ko uski sundarta sahit dekhna, par uski pakad se bandhna nahi.

Jeevan ko prem se jeena hai.

Zimmedari se jeena hai.

Karuna se jeena hai.

Par bheetar ki swatantrata ki disha nahi bhoolni hai.

Naam aur roop ke is vishal khel mein, saakshi ki shant upasthiti ko yaad rakhna hi sadhana hai.

Adhyay 2 yahin poorn hota hai.

Sansar pehle jaisa dikh sakta hai, par dekhne ki drishti pehle jaisi rehni zaroori nahi.

sections.title: Is Saptah ke Liye Abhyas
sections.content:
Agle saat din tak ek halka abhyas karo.

Din mein kam se kam ek baar kisi ghatna ko dekhkar ruko. Ghatna chhoti bhi ho sakti hai - kisi ne praise ki, kisi ne criticism ki, koi kaam bigad gaya, koi kaam achha hua, mausam badla, man prasann hua, man bhaari hua.

Phir apne aap se teen prashn pucho:

"Naam aur roop ke level par yeh ghatna kya hai?"

"Mera man isme kaun si kahani jod raha hai?"

"Vyavahar mein mujhe kya zimmedari nibhani hai, aur bheetar kis pakad ko dheela karna hai?"

Saptah ke ant mein do minute baithkar dekho:

Kahan sansar ne mujhe bahut kheench liya?

Kahan mujhe yaad raha ki sab badalne wala hai?

Kahan karuna, zimmedari aur saakshi-bhav saath chal paye?

Ise bojh mat banao. Ise jeevan ko nayi drishti se dekhne ka abhyas banao.

Maya ko samajhna sansar chhodna nahi hai.

Maya ko samajhna sansar mein jagkar jeena hai.

exercises.title: Aaj ke Liye Abhyas
exercises.content:
Aaj kisi ek sadharan vastu ya ghatna ko dhyan se dekho. Yeh cup ho sakta hai, ped ho sakta hai, sadak par chalti bheed ho sakti hai, baarish ho sakti hai, koi awaaz ho sakti hai, ya kisi vyakti ka chehra ho sakta hai.

Use dekhte hue dheere se pucho:

"Yeh mujhe kaise dikh raha hai?"

"Kya yeh sabko aise hi dikhta hoga?"

"Is anubhav mein bahar ki vastu kitni hai, aur mere man ki yaad, pasand, napasand ya arth kitna jud raha hai?"

Answer banane ki jaldi mat karo. Bas dekho.

Sansar ko pehli baar ki tarah dekhna shuru karo.

exercises.title: Aaj ke Liye Abhyas
exercises.content:
Aaj din mein kisi bhi teen vastu ya sambandh ko dekhkar naam aur roop ka khel pehchano.

Ek cup ko dekho aur pucho - "Naam cup hai, roop cup jaisa hai, par padarth kya hai?"

Ek ghar ko dekho aur pucho - "Naam is ghar ka alag hai, par ise banane wale tattva kahan se aaye?"

Kisi vyakti ko dekhkar pucho - "Main ise naam, role aur purane anubhav se dekh raha hoon, ya abhi sach mein dekh raha hoon?"

Phir dheere se yeh vaakya yaad karo:

"Naam aur roop badalte hain, par koi gehra aadhar hai jis par sab prakat hai."

Answer banane ki jaldi mat karo. Bas naam aur roop ko dekho. Yahin se Maya ki samajh anubhav mein utarna shuru hoti hai.
